description: This file contains a Roslyn analyzer class 'IncorrectAttributeUseAnalyzer' that checks for incorrect attribute usage on classes inheriting from Grain in Orleans framework. It defines diagnostic rules, initializes analysis, and reports diagnostics if specific attributes are misused.

classes.name: IncorrectAttributeUseAnalyzer
classes.description: A diagnostic analyzer class for detecting incorrect attribute usage in Orleans grain classes.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the analysis context, enabling concurrent execution, configuring code analysis, and registering syntax node actions.

methods.name: CheckSyntaxNode
methods.description: Analyzes class declaration syntax nodes to determine if they inherit from Grain and checks for specific attribute misuse.

methods.name: TryReportFor
methods.description: Checks if a class has a specific attribute and reports a diagnostic if so.
